name: no-yolo
description: Guard hooks for agent-written code (the guardrails guard): secrets stopped at commit, no push to a protected branch without a recorded test pass and review of the exact code, and production locked until a human approves. With a second check in git's own pre-push hook, a read-only reviewer agent and four skills: you-shall-not-push, done-done, who-let-you-in and mind-the-headers. Formerly the guardrails plugin.
